question: What event at the fall of the body marks the culminating moment?
premises: The time is the fall of the body
The skull is pierced at that time
inference: At bodily death, the piercing of the skull occurs as the decisive moment.
uncertainties: kapālambhidyate is a fused form; exact parsing depends on sandhi
plain_english: O goddess, when the body falls, then the skull is pierced.
